summary: Iter16 KYC self-service + admin docs: 14/14 backend tests PASS, all frontend testids verified on /my-documents, /dashboard, and /admin/sellers (seller-docs modal). Regression: smoke.sh + ledger e2e + onboarding queue all PASS.

issues: Status row reads 'KYC: verified VERIFIED' — the literal status string and the colored badge both render, slight visual duplication. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: kyc_docs.py correctly uses `user is None` (not truthy check) because Mongo projection of missing fields returns {} — verified and confirmed safe.
image_b64 is stripped from list_docs() responses via _serialize_docs() — admin GET /admin/sellers/{id}/documents confirmed to NOT leak raw base64.
Whole-batch approve sets is_verified=true; per-doc rejection only mutates that doc's review_status and rejection_reason. Both behaviors verified.
Admin-direct upload sets review_status='approved' and preserves prior kyc_status (does NOT auto-promote to pending_review) — confirmed working.

MyDocumentsPage uses `useAuthStore.isAuthenticated` for gating — raw `fetch+cookie` login does NOT hydrate Zustand store, so the page shows 'Sign in to upload documents'. UI login flow correctly hydrates store and unlocks the 5-card grid. Behavior is correct; just noted for the next testing agent.
Mongo projection `{kyc_status:1, kyc_documents:1}` against a user without those fields returns {} — confirmed by the smoke uploads.
test_credentials: Primary test user +255712345678 / test1234 (now kyc_status=approved after this run). Admin +255700000001 / AdminPass123!. New fresh user auto-created per run for empty-submit test.
seed_data_creation: test_submit_with_missing_docs_returns_400 creates a fresh user each run via /api/auth/register with a uuid-suffixed phone. No long-lived TEST_* artifacts beyond what already existed in iter15.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary test user (+255712345678) ends each run with kyc_status='approved' + is_verified=true because the admin-batch-approve test runs last. If you need to re-test pending_review flow, re-upload any of the 5 docs (POST /auth/kyc/documents) which flips status back to pending_review. /my-documents requires UI-based login (filling the form + clicking submit) — direct API login + cookie won't hydrate the Zustand store; this is correct app behavior, not a bug. seller-docs-* testids on /admin/sellers use pattern `seller-docs-{user_id}` for the row button.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature addition, no regressions found. Original user complaint ('Seller cant see option to load documents') is resolved: dashboard now shows 'Verify Account' CTA (data-testid=dashboard-my-documents-btn) → /my-documents → 5-card upload grid with camera + gallery + submit. Admin has parallel path via /admin/sellers row 'Docs' button → SellerDocsModal with per-doc upload + approve/reject.
